ownChecks.question: Did any lens finding fail verification?
ownChecks.answer:
Two were refuted:
- R1-04, as framed: it is a disclosure gap, now CC-04, not a settled rule.
- F5: M:762 discloses the unresolved per-command authority reference.
Severity corrections I accept: R1-02 and F2 from P2 to P3. The defect is latent behind enforced holds, it is the literal doc 55 CR-06 rule, and the hold's sourceChange ('allocation within unchanged walls') already forces lower ceilings. upheld.claim: CR-03 is carried as a code-enforced hold, not corrected. With G0 forced into every window, no mode is eligible, PREPARE included. Even if every manifest hold were satisfied, the code gate still blocks G0, G1, G4 and G7. Doc 55 section 3 required a paused continuation or an explicit Q-3 qualification; neither exists. Sources: lens R1-01, lens R3 F1, all verifiers. Evidence: S:1312-1317@defe073 (child counts 7/4/3/6), S:1113, S:188/192/1137 before S:1161, S:179-181, S:370-371, S:1474.

Alternatively, restructure the multi-child groups into reviewed single-child stages under unchanged caps, or put an explicit Q-3 qualification before Samuel. Then re-hash, refresh the records and return the result to the original reviewer.

upheld.claim: requireCommandTime (S:1038-1043) can never pass for G2, G3, G5 or G6, because each single command's wallMs equals its group wall (M:5777/5807, 8847/8876, 18691/18716, 19156/19179). G7 (requires G6) can therefore never start. The refusal fires after the attempt record (S:1369) and the full inventory (S:1375), burning a run-wide attempt each time. The hold at M:32590 and closure CR-06 describe an unproven fit, not an impossible one. Sources: R1-02, R2-F1, F2; final severity P3.
upheld.fix: Refuse statically in assertStageEligibility, before the lock and attempt, when a command's wallMs is at least its group wall minus a frozen overhead allocation. Restate DOC55-G1-G6-WALL-FIT to require lower command ceilings bound in approvalScope (a tightening), or an explicit separate wall decision. Re-hash.

upheld.claim: This is a regression from 1e808ba. Re-invoking a group that an earlier invocation consumed now records false evidence uncertainty and keeps run-exclusive.lock.json, so every later group in the run refuses. The trace is S:1351 refusal, S:1429 archival attempt, S:1433 attemptId mismatch, S:1441 evidenceUncertain, S:1449 cleanupProven false, S:1482 no release, S:1119 refusal. The old guard was run.groupConsumed && receipts.length===0 (old S:1208), with release at old S:1246. Sources: R1-03 and R3 verifier M1.
upheld.fix: Archive only a marker this invocation wrote (run.groupConsumed && marker.attemptId === run.attemptId). Treat a pre-existing marker as a clean non-consuming refusal that releases the lock. Add an authored fixture and re-hash.

upheld.claim: The CR-03 lift route (M:32571ff), closure CR-03 and the packet frame the resumed-invocation charge as an open choice but omit the binding arithmetic. Attempts are counted run-wide (S:1357-1358), maximumAttempts is at most 9 (S:216-217, M:742), a full G0-G7 run needs 8 first invocations, and G0 alone may pause up to 6 times. Under the existing per-invocation default (M:752), a complete run tolerates one pause or refusal in total. This replaces R1-04 and F1's 'already answered' sub-claim. Source: R1 verifier MR-01.

upheld.claim: Moving the effective-policy observation before verification removed its freshness bound. 1e808ba required observedAt >= approved; S:267-268@defe073 requires only observedAt <= verifiedAt. Undefined rows refuse (M:201), so the bound record is a curated scope subset with no precedence computed. A later or omitted higher-scope AllSigned would surface only after consumeGroup (S:1203), before the spawn (S:1210), leaving the group consumed and HELD_UNRESOLVED. Sources: R2-F2, F3.

Require all five scopes, with Undefined permitted as data, and derive the effective policy by precedence. Re-hash.

upheld.claim: CR-08 is only partly closed. The nine lift routes name action classes but no concrete vehicle (argv, inputs, caps or a G0 case id); only TAP has a proposedAction. The CLI has no calibration mode (S:367-384), and no lift order exists among the routes that need runs of held mechanisms (G0_ONE_MINUTE, G0_THREE_PROCESS, MEMORY, HANDLE, CR03). Give TAP and Vitest all five fields, and align M:228 and the G0_ONE_MINUTE text with the source. Re-hash.

Preparation plus all group walls total 6,660,000 ms of 8,400,000, leaving at most 29 minutes for R4 latency plus all handshakes and idle time. This is the unbudgeted residue of the doc 55 CR-07 ask.
